questions.question: A cyclist covers a distance of 800 m in 2 minutes. Find the speed (in km/hr) of the cyclist.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Directly convert the given distance and time into km and hours to get the speed in km/hr.

Distance = 800 m = 0.8 km

Time = 2 minutes = 2 ÷ 60 hr = 1/30 hr

Speed = Distance ÷ Time = 0.8 ÷ (1/30) = 0.8 × 30 = 24 km/hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 24 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance covered by the cyclist = 800 m

Time taken = 2 minutes

 
• 
 
 
 Distance = 800 m
 Time = 2 mins
 Speed = ? km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

Conversion: 1 m/s = 18/5 km/hr

**Calculations:**

⇒ Convert the time into seconds: 2 minutes = 2 × 60 = 120 seconds.

⇒ Speed in m/s = 800 ÷ 120

⇒ Speed = 20/3 m/s

⇒ To convert m/s into km/hr, multiply by 18/5.

⇒ Speed in km/hr = (20/3) × (18/5)

⇒ Speed = 4 × 6 = 24 km/hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 24 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unit Conversions

To convert speed from km/hr to m/s, multiply the value by 5/18.

To convert speed from m/s to km/hr, multiply the value by 18/5.

Average Speed

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time.

If two equal distances are covered at speeds a and b, then the average speed is 2ab ÷ (a + b).

Relative Speed

When two objects move in the same direction, their Relative Speed = Difference of speeds (S₁ − S₂).

When they move in opposite directions, their Relative Speed = Sum of speeds (S₁ + S₂).
</p

questions.question: In quadrilateral PQRS, the bisectors of angle R and angle S meet at the point T (inside the quadrilateral) and angle STR = 48^circ . If the ratio of angle P to angle Q is 3 : 5 , then what is the difference between the measures of angle Q and angle P ?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

By direct geometry property, the angle between the bisectors of two adjacent angles of a quadrilateral is half the sum of the other two adjacent angles.

⇒ ∠P + ∠Q = 2 × ∠STR = 2 × 48° = 96°

⇒ Total ratio parts for ∠P and ∠Q = 3 + 5 = 8 parts.

⇒ 8 parts = 96° ⇒ 1 part = 12°

⇒ Difference = 5 parts − 3 parts = 2 parts = 24°

**∴ The correct answer is 24°.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

∠STR = 48°

Ratio of ∠P : ∠Q = 3 : 5

Let ∠P = 3x and ∠Q = 5x

**Calculations:**

⇒ In ΔTSR, the sum of all angles is 180°.

⇒ ∠TSR + ∠TRS + ∠STR = 180°

⇒ (∠S / 2) + (∠R / 2) + 48° = 180°

⇒ (∠S + ∠R) / 2 = 180° − 48° = 132°

⇒ ∠S + ∠R = 132° × 2 = 264°

⇒ In quadrilateral PQRS, the sum of all interior angles is 360°.

⇒ ∠P + ∠Q + ∠R + ∠S = 360°

⇒ 3x + 5x + 264° = 360°

⇒ 8x = 360° − 264° = 96°

⇒ x = 12°

⇒ Difference between ∠Q and ∠P = 5x − 3x = 2x

⇒ Difference = 2 × 12° = 24°

**∴ The correct answer is 24°.**

**__Additional Information__**

Interior Angles of a Polygon

The sum of all interior angles of a convex polygon with n sides is given by the formula (n − 2) × 180°. For a quadrilateral (n = 4), the sum is 360°.

Angle Bisectors in Quadrilaterals

When the bisectors of two adjacent angles of a quadrilateral meet, the angle formed at their intersection is exactly equal to half the sum of the remaining two non-adjacent angles. Formula: ∠Intersection = (∠Other1 + ∠Other2) / 2.

Cyclic Quadrilateral

If a quadrilateral is inscribed inside a circle, it is called a cyclic quadrilateral. The sum of its opposite interior angles is always exactly 180°.

questions.question: A solid metallic sphere of radius 9 cm is melted and recast into 27 smaller solid spheres of equal size. Find the surface area of one small sphere.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume is conserved ⇒ radius scales with cube root

27 small spheres ⇒ radius becomes 1/3 of original

New radius = 9 ÷ 3 = 3 cm

Surface area = 4πr² = 4π(3²) = 36π

**∴ Answer = 36π**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of big sphere = 9 cm, Number of small spheres = 27

**Formula used:**

Volume of sphere = (4/3)πr³, Surface area = 4πr²

 9 cm 

Big sphere volume = 27 × (small sphere volume)

**Calculation:**

⇒ (4/3)π(9)³ = 27 × (4/3)πr³

⇒ 9³ = 27r³

⇒ 729 = 27r³

⇒ r³ = 27 ⇒ r = 3 cm

⇒ Surface area = 4πr² = 4π(3²) = 36π

**∴ The correct answer is 36π cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume Conservation

When a solid is recast, total volume remains constant.

Sphere Volume

Volume = (4/3)πr³

Surface Area

Surface area = 4πr²

Scaling Rule

If number of spheres = n, new radius = original radius ÷ cube root of n.

questions.question: A wholesaler bought goods for ₹15,000 and sold them to a retailer at 20% profit. The retailer then sold the goods to customers at 25% profit. What is the final selling price to customers?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Successive profit multiplier = 1.2 × 1.25

= 1.5

Final price = 15000 × 1.5

= 22500

**∴ Answer = 22500**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Cost Price = 15000, Profit₁ = 20%, Profit₂ = 25%

**Formula used:**

Selling Price = CP × (1 + p₁/100) × (1 + p₂/100)

**Calculation:**

⇒ After wholesaler profit: SP₁ = 15000 × 1.2 = 18000

⇒ After retailer profit: SP₂ = 18000 × 1.25 = 22500

**∴ The correct answer is 22500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Profit

Final price = CP × (1 + p₁/100) × (1 + p₂/100)

Multiplier Method

Convert percentage into multiplier (e.g., 20% ⇒ 1.2)

Combined Profit

Net multiplier = product of individual multipliers

Quick Insight

Successive profits multiply, not add.

questions.question: ₹6,874 is to be divided among three persons X, Y and Z. If the shares of X and Y are in the ratio 5 : 9 and that of Y and Z are in the ratio 9 : 7, what is the share (in ₹) of Y?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Make Y common: X : Y = 5 : 9 and Y : Z = 9 : 7

So combined ratio = 5 : 9 : 7

Total parts = 5 + 9 + 7 = 21

Value of 1 part = 6874 ÷ 21

Y's share = 9 parts = 9 × (6874 ÷ 21) = 2946

**∴ Answer = 2946**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total amount = 6874, X : Y = 5 : 9, Y : Z = 9 : 7

**Formula used:**

Equalize middle term to combine ratios

**Calculation:**

⇒ X : Y = 5 : 9 and Y : Z = 9 : 7

⇒ Combined ratio = X : Y : Z = 5 : 9 : 7

⇒ Total parts = 5 + 9 + 7 = 21

⇒ Value of 1 part = 6874 ÷ 21 × 9 = 2946

**∴ The correct answer is 2946.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Combining Ratios

When two ratios share a common term, align that term to merge into a single ratio.

Division in Ratio

Share = (Individual part / Total parts) × Total amount

Shortcut Insight

If middle term already matches, directly combine ratios.

Check

Sum of all shares must equal total amount.

questions.question: Keshav spends 70% of his income. If he saves ₹18,000, then his income (in ₹) is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Savings % = 100% − Expenditure % = 100% − 70% = 30%

Given 30% of Income = ₹18,000

1% of Income = 18,000 ÷ 30 = 600

Total Income (100%) = 600 × 100 = ₹60,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹60,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 
 
• 
 Expenditure (70%)
 Savings (30%)
 

 ₹18,000
 

 Total Income = 100% = ?

**Given:**

Expenditure = 70% of Income

Savings = ₹18,000

**Formula Used:**

Income = Expenditure + Savings

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the total income of Keshav be x.

⇒ Expenditure = 70% of x = 0.70x

⇒ Savings = Total Income − Expenditure

⇒ Savings = x − 0.70x = 0.30x

⇒ We are given that savings = ₹18,000.

⇒ 0.30x = 18,000

⇒ x = 18,000 ÷ 0.30 = 60,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹60,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Income-Expenditure Concept

Total Income is always considered as 100%. If expenditure is given as a percentage, then Savings % = 100% − Expenditure %.

Percentage Base Change

If P% of a number is X, then the total number (Base) can be calculated using the direct relation: Base = (X ÷ P) × 100.

Successive Percentage Change

When a given value changes successively by a% and then by b%, the overall net percentage change is given by the formula (a + b + ab ÷ 100)%.

questions.question:
What is the mode of the following data?

53, 47, 53, 48, 53, 53, 40, 41, 50, 50, 55, 48, 54, 49, 49, 51, 46, 45
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The mode is simply the value that occurs most frequently in a given dataset.

By visually scanning the given numbers, we can spot the repeating terms.

The number 53 appears 4 times, which is strictly greater than any other number's occurrence.

Thus, the most frequent value is 53.

**∴ The correct answer is 53.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Data set: 53, 47, 53, 48, 53, 53, 40, 41, 50, 50, 55, 48, 54, 49, 49, 51, 46, 45

**Concept Used:**

Mode = The observation with the highest frequency in a dataset.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Arrange the given data in ascending order to easily count the frequencies:

⇒ 40, 41, 45, 46, 47, 48, 48, 49, 49, 50, 50, 51, 53, 53, 53, 53, 54, 55

⇒ Frequency of 48 = 2

⇒ Frequency of 49 = 2

⇒ Frequency of 50 = 2

⇒ Frequency of 53 = 4

⇒ All other numbers (40, 41, 45, 46, 47, 51, 54, 55) have a frequency of 1.

⇒ The maximum frequency is 4, which corresponds to the value 53.

**∴ The correct answer is 53.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean (Average)

The arithmetic average of a dataset, calculated by dividing the sum of all observations by the total number of observations.

Median

The middle value of a dataset when arranged in ascending or descending order. If the number of observations is even, it is the mean of the two middle values.

Empirical Relationship

For a moderately skewed distribution, the relationship between Mean, Median, and Mode is given by: Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean.

Bimodal Data

If a dataset has two distinct values with the same highest frequency, it is called bimodal (having two modes).
</p

questions.question: Walking at (5)/(6) th of his normal speed from his home, Lakshya is 24 minutes late in reaching his office. The usual time taken by him to cover the distance between his home and his office is
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Speed becomes 5/6 ⇒ Time becomes 6/5

Extra time = 1/5 of usual time

Given extra time = 24 min

So usual time = 24 × 5 = 120 min

**∴ Answer = 120 minutes**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

New speed = (5/6) of normal speed, Delay = 24 minutes

**Formula used:**

Time is inversely proportional to speed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let usual time = t minutes

⇒ New time = t × (6/5)

⇒ Extra time = t × (6/5) − t

⇒ = t(1/5)

⇒ t/5 = 24

⇒ t = 24 × 5 = 120 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 120 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Inverse Relation

If speed decreases, time increases proportionally.

Time Factor

If speed becomes a/b, time becomes b/a

Delay Concept

Extra time = New time − Usual time

Shortcut Insight

Directly relate fractional increase in time to given delay.

questions.question: The amount on a sum of ₹4,900 at 10% per annum compound interest, compounded annually, in 2 years will be:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The effective rate of compound interest for 2 years at 10% per annum can be found using the successive percentage formula: 10 + 10 + (10 × 10) / 100 = 21%.

This means the total interest earned over 2 years is 21% of the principal.

Total amount after 2 years = Principal × (100% + 21%)

Amount = 121% of ₹4,900 = 1.21 × 4,900 = ₹5,929.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹5,929.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 
 

 
 
 
• 
 
 
 
 
 
 Year 0
 Year 1
 Year 2
 
 ₹4900
 ₹5390
 ₹5929
 
 

 

 
 +10% (₹490)
 +10% (₹539)
 
 Total Amount after 2 years = ₹5929

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹4,900

Rate of Interest (R) = 10% per annum

Time Period (T) = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Compound Amount (A) = P × (1 + R/100)T

**Calculations:**

⇒ A = 4900 × (1 + 10/100)²

⇒ A = 4900 × (110/100)²

⇒ A = 4900 × (11/10) × (11/10)

⇒ A = 4900 × 121 / 100

⇒ A = 49 × 121

⇒ A = 5929

**∴ The correct answer is ₹5,929.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Effective Interest Rate for 2 Years

For a rate of R% compounded annually, the effective rate for 2 years is calculated as R + R + (R × R)/100 %.

Difference Between CI and SI for 2 Years

The formula for the difference between Compound Interest and Simple Interest on a principal P for 2 years is Diff = P × (R/100)².

Half-Yearly Compounding

When interest is compounded half-yearly, the rate of interest is halved (R/2) and the time period is doubled (2T) because there are two cycles per year.

questions.question: The mode of a distribution is 21 and the mean is 60. The value of its median is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a moderately skewed distribution, the empirical relationship is: Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean

21 = 3 × Median − 2 × 60

21 = 3 × Median − 120

3 × Median = 141 ⇒ Median = 47

**∴ The correct answer is 47.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Mean = 60

Mode = 21

**Formula Used:**

Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean

 
• 
 
 
 
 
 
 Mode
 21

 Median
 47

 Mean
 60
 
 

 Distance = 2x (26)
 
 

 Distance = x (13)

 Median divides Mean and Mode internally in 1:2 ratio

**Calculations:**

⇒ Substituting the given values in the empirical formula:

⇒ 21 = 3 × Median − 2 × 60

⇒ 21 = 3 × Median − 120

⇒ 3 × Median = 120 + 21

⇒ 3 × Median = 141

⇒ Median = 141 ÷ 3

⇒ Median = 47

**∴ The correct answer is 47.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Empirical Relationship

For a moderately skewed distribution, the difference between Mean and Mode is three times the difference between Mean and Median. This leads to the formula: Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean.

Positively Skewed Distribution

The tail of the distribution is on the right side. In this case, Mean > Median > Mode. The given question falls under this category as 60 > 47 > 21.

Negatively Skewed Distribution

The tail of the distribution is on the left side. In this case, Mean < Median < Mode.

questions.question: The sum of two numbers P and Q is 17 and their product is 56. Find the value of P² + Q² .
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use identity: P² + Q² = (P + Q)² − 2PQ

= 17² − 2 × 56

= 289 − 112

= 177

**∴ Answer = 177**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

P + Q = 17, PQ = 56

**Formula used:**

P² + Q² = (P + Q)² − 2PQ

**Calculation:**

⇒ (P + Q)² = 17² = 289

⇒ 2PQ = 2 × 56 = 112

⇒ P² + Q² = 289 − 112

⇒ = 177

**∴ The correct answer is 177.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Algebraic Identity

P² + Q² = (P + Q)² − 2PQ

Other Identity

(P − Q)² = (P + Q)² − 4PQ

Usage Tip

Useful when sum and product are given directly.

Quick Insight

Avoid solving for individual values when identities can simplify directly.

questions.question: P and Q together can fill a cistern with water in 7 hours. If P alone can fill the cistern with water in 56 hours, then in how many hours will Q alone fill one-fourth of the same cistern with water?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let Total Work = LCM(7, 56) = 56 units

Efficiency of (P + Q) = 56 ÷ 7 = 8 units/hour

Efficiency of P = 56 ÷ 56 = 1 unit/hour

Efficiency of Q = 8 − 1 = 7 units/hour

Work = 1/4 of 56 = 14 units ⇒ Time = 14 ÷ 7 = 2 hours

**∴ Answer = 2 hours**

questions.question: The expenditure of Sudha is 150% more than her savings. If her expenditure decreases by 7% and savings increase by 21%, then by what percentage does her income increase?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assume savings = 100 ⇒ expenditure = 250

Initial income = 350

New expenditure = 250 × 0.93 = 232.5

New savings = 100 × 1.21 = 121

New income = 232.5 + 121 = 353.5

Increase = 3.5 ⇒ % increase = (3.5/350) × 100 = 1%

**∴ Answer = 1%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expenditure = 150% more than savings, Changes: −7% expenditure, +21% savings

**Formula used:**

Income = Savings + Expenditure

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let savings = 100

⇒ Expenditure = 250

⇒ Initial income = 350

⇒ New expenditure = 250 × 0.93 = 232.5

⇒ New savings = 100 × 1.21 = 121

⇒ New income = 232.5 + 121 = 353.5

⇒ Increase = 3.5

⇒ % increase = (3.5/350) × 100 = 1%

**∴ The correct answer is 1%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Income Relation

Income = Savings + Expenditure

Percentage Change

New value = Original × (1 ± change/100)

Assumption Technique

Taking 100 simplifies percentage-based problems.

Key Insight

Compare total before and after to find percentage change.

questions.question: An item with a marked price of ₹606 was sold for ₹304. What was the percentage of discount given? (Round off your answer to two decimal places.)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Discount = MP − SP = 606 − 304 = 302

Discount % = (302 ÷ 606) × 100

= (151 ÷ 303) × 100

≈ 49.83%

**∴ Answer = 49.83%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marked Price = 606, Selling Price = 304

**Formula used:**

Discount % = [(MP − SP) ÷ MP] × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Discount = 606 − 304 = 302

⇒ Discount % = (302 ÷ 606) × 100

⇒ = 0.49835 × 100

⇒ = 49.83% (approx)

**∴ The correct answer is 49.83%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Discount Formula

Discount % = [(Marked Price − Selling Price) ÷ Marked Price] × 100

Quick Calculation

Simplify fraction before multiplying to reduce effort.

questions.question: A father’s current age is three times the age of his son. Five years ago from now, the father’s age was four times the age of his son at that time. What are their present ages?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let son = x ⇒ father = 3x

5 years ago: father = 3x − 5, son = x − 5

Given: 3x − 5 = 4(x − 5)

⇒ 3x − 5 = 4x − 20 ⇒ x = 15

Son = 15, Father = 45

**∴ Answer = Father 45 years, Son 15 years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Father’s age = 3 × son’s age, and 5 years ago father was 4 times son

**Formula used:**

Form linear equations using present and past ages

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let present age of son = x

⇒ Present age of father = 3x

⇒ 5 years ago: son = x − 5, father = 3x − 5

⇒ According to condition: 3x − 5 = 4(x − 5)

⇒ 3x − 5 = 4x − 20

⇒ 3x − 4x = −20 + 5

⇒ −x = −15 ⇒ x = 15

⇒ Son = 15 years

⇒ Father = 3x = 45 years

**∴ The correct answer is Father = 45 years, Son = 15 years.**

questions.question: Find the value of 5sec²theta – 5tan²theta .
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Given expression: 5sec²θ − 5tan²θ

Take 5 common from both the terms.

⇒ 5(sec²θ − tan²θ)

We know the standard trigonometric identity: sec²θ − tan²θ = 1

⇒ 5 × 1 = 5

**∴ The correct answer is 5.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression = 5sec²θ − 5tan²θ

**Formula Used:**

secθ = 1 / cosθ

tanθ = sinθ / cosθ

sin²θ + cos²θ = 1 ⇒ 1 − sin²θ = cos²θ

**Calculations:**

⇒ 5(1 / cos²θ) − 5(sin²θ / cos²θ)

⇒ (5 − 5sin²θ) / cos²θ

⇒ 5(1 − sin²θ) / cos²θ

⇒ 5cos²θ / cos²θ

⇒ 5

**∴ The correct answer is 5.**

**__Additional Information__**

Basic Trigonometric Identities

1. sin²θ + cos²θ = 1

2. 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ ⇒ sec²θ − tan²θ = 1

3. 1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ ⇒ cosec²θ − cot²θ = 1

Trigonometric Ratios

secθ is the reciprocal of cosθ, i.e., secθ = 1 / cosθ

tanθ is the ratio of sine and cosine, i.e., tanθ = sinθ / cosθ

questions.question: The monthly incomes of two friends Vipul and Vijay, are in the ratio 5 : 8, respectively, and each of them saves ₹84,000 every month. If the ratio of their monthly expenditure is 1 : 4, find the monthly income of Vipul (in ₹).
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let incomes = 5x and 8x, expenditures = y and 4y

Savings same ⇒ 5x − y = 84000 and 8x − 4y = 84000

Subtract ⇒ 3x − 3y = 0 ⇒ x = y

Put in first ⇒ 5x − x = 84000 ⇒ 4x = 84000

x = 21000 ⇒ Vipul income = 5x = 105000

**∴ Answer = 105000**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Income ratio = 5 : 8, Expenditure ratio = 1 : 4, Savings = 84000

Income = Expenditure + Savings

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let income of Vipul = 5x and Vijay = 8x

⇒ Let expenditure = y and 4y

⇒ 5x − y = 84000 ...(1)

⇒ 8x − 4y = 84000 ...(2)

⇒ Subtract (1) from (2): 3x − 3y = 0

⇒ x = y

⇒ Substitute in (1): 5x − x = 84000

⇒ 4x = 84000

⇒ x = 21000

⇒ Vipul income = 5x = 105000

**∴ The correct answer is 105000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

questions.question: What is the Highest Common Factor (HCF) of 252 and 378?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Break into common factors

252 = 36 × 7, 378 = 54 × 7

Common part = 18 × 7 = 126

**∴ Answer = 126**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Numbers = 252 and 378

**Formula used:**

HCF = Product of common prime factors with least powers

**Calculation:**

⇒ 252 = 2² × 3² × 7

⇒ 378 = 2 × 3³ × 7

⇒ Common factors = 2¹, 3², 7

⇒ HCF = 2 × 9 × 7 = 126

**∴ The correct answer is 126.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

HCF is the largest number that divides both numbers exactly.

Express numbers as product of primes to find HCF easily.

Repeated division method can also be used to find HCF.

Quick Insight

Always take lowest powers of common primes.

questions.question: Find the single equivalent discount (rounded off to two decimal places) for successive discounts of 23%, 11%, and 29%.

Remaining % = (100 − 23)(100 − 11)(100 − 29) / 100²

= 77 × 89 × 71 / 10000

= 486563 / 10000 = 48.6563%

Equivalent discount = 100 − 48.6563 = 51.3437%

**∴ Answer ≈ 51.34%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Successive discounts = 23%, 11%, 29%

⇒ Remaining after 23% = 77%

⇒ Remaining after 11% = 89%

⇒ Remaining after 29% = 71%

⇒ Net remaining = 0.77 × 0.89 × 0.71

⇒ = 0.48656 (approx)

⇒ Equivalent discount = 100 − 48.656 = 51.34%

**∴ The correct answer is 51.34%.**

questions.question: The present age of Ramesh is 3 times that of Mahesh. Five years ago, the ratio of their ages was 4 : 1. What is the present age of Ramesh?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let Mahesh = x ⇒ Ramesh = 3x

5 years ago: (3x − 5) : (x − 5) = 4 : 1

⇒ 3x − 5 = 4(x − 5)

⇒ 3x − 5 = 4x − 20 ⇒ x = 15

Ramesh = 3x = 45

**∴ Answer = 45**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ramesh = 3 × Mahesh, and 5 years ago ratio = 4 : 1

**Formula used:**

Form equation using ratio of past ages

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let present age of Mahesh = x

⇒ Present age of Ramesh = 3x

⇒ 5 years ago: Mahesh = x − 5, Ramesh = 3x − 5

⇒ (3x − 5) / (x − 5) = 4 / 1

⇒ 3x − 5 = 4(x − 5)

⇒ 3x − 5 = 4x − 20

⇒ 3x − 4x = −20 + 5

⇒ −x = −15 ⇒ x = 15

⇒ Ramesh = 3x = 45

**∴ The correct answer is 45.**
